prompt: A hulking elemental of dark loam, moss-slicked granite boulders and tangled tree-roots heaves itself upright out of a grassy hillside, hunched and mid-stride, dirt and grass clods falling from its shoulders. A torn brown scar gapes in the ground beneath it where the creature has just pulled its own body free, exposing pale fresh soil. Deep emerald grass and lichen still cover its back. Two faint glowing green eyes. The background is a misty old-growth forest at dawn under an overcast sky.

Side profile of a walking earth elemental striding south, its body a stacked column of green sod, grey fieldstone boulders and a tangle of pale roots. The grassy turf of the ground peels and lifts up behind its trailing leg, flowing upward into its body like a ribbon of lawn, so the creature is visibly made of the same land it walks on. Deep emerald grass on its shoulders, crumbs of brown soil sifting from its limbs. The background is a sunlit green meadow with low rolling hills.

Extreme low close-up of a patch of mossy brown earth coming alive: two large glowing lime-green eyes open for the first time in the soil, and a jagged crack splits the dirt into a gaping mouth. Pale tree-roots at the edges flex and curl upward like grasping fingers, lifting clods of grass. The waking ground bulges into the rough shape of a face. The background is a shadowed forest floor scattered with ferns and fallen leaves, dim and earthy.

A humanoid elemental tearing itself up out of flat grassy ground, caught half-risen: its upper body of loam, fieldstone and roots is already upright with glowing green eyes, while its lower half is still fused to the earth, legs not yet separated from the soil they are forming out of. Long roots stretch like tendons between the rising torso and the torn ground, grass clods peeling upward. A dark gouge of bare brown soil marks where the land lifted. The background is a quiet green meadow at dusk.

A wide mound of mossy brown earth rears up off the forest floor and wakes: two glowing lime-green eyes blaze open near the top, a deep jagged crack splits open beneath them into a wide rocky mouth, and thick pale roots peel up out of the dirt like reaching arms. Tufts of emerald grass and lichen coat its lumpy hide. Clods of soil tumble off as it lifts. The background is a dim old-growth forest of fern and fallen logs, earthy and shadowed.
